summary: Use Fractal throughout Rust CLI help, human diagnostics, setup, terminal UI prose and package metadata.

replay.detail: No claim replay or history rewriting.

schema.detail: No schema or serialized value changes.

rules.detail: No lifecycle or admission rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Human CLI stderr uses fractal:; native-driver and exec-gate diagnostics retain their legacy prefixes. The delivery probe accepts both prefixes. Installed aliases, wire values, client identities, environment variables, state paths and service labels are unchanged.

downtime.detail: Presentation changes require no service cutover.

recovery.detail: Existing recovery commands and durable state remain compatible.
